Name: prioritized_experience_replay
Title: Prioritized Experience Replay with Temporal-Difference Error Sampling
Experiment: Replace uniform replay buffer sampling with TD-error based priority sampling, applying importance sampling correction weights to stabilize policy gradient updates.

Name: curiosity_driven_intrinsic_reward
Title: Curiosity-Driven Intrinsic Exploration via Forward Dynamics Error
Experiment: Augment environmental extrinsic reward with intrinsic novelty reward computed from forward state prediction error in sparse-reward environments.
